en.quote: We will not increase the tax burden on non-resource sectors.
en.head: Corporate profit tax: 25%; VAT: 22%
en.body: On July 12, 2024, Putin signed a law introducing progressive personal income tax rates from January 1, 2025 (15%, 18%, 20% and 22% on annual income above 2.4 million rubles) and raising the corporate profit tax from 20% to 25%. On November 28, 2025, he signed a law raising VAT to 22% from 2026.

notes: The Russian phrase “non-resource sectors” refers to sectors outside the extractive industries.
